dgp.name: negative_binomial_size1_counts_weibull_excess_with_active_bulk
dgp.non_poisson_certificate: tail count variance = mean + mean^2/size = 930, 31 times the Poisson variance at the same mean; zero-tail month probability = 1/31
dgp.non_gpd_certificate: Weibull survival exp(-(x/scale)^shape) with shape 1.5 is not a generalized Pareto survival law; the survival log has nonzero curvature in x, unlike exponential xi=0 and unlike log(1+xi*x/sigma) GPD log-survival
dgp.baseline_relation: Retains the fixed 200-event Beta bulk and threshold; replaces the Poisson count by NB(size=1, mean=30) and GPD excesses by Weibull(shape=1.5, scale=30000). In zero-tail months (probability 1/31), the baseline bulk determines the monthly maximum. This is a joint misspecification challenge; count and excess-law effects are not separately identified.

scientific_signature.estimator_mode: full settings from frozen base revision.yaml; TAIL uses audited fit_tail(kind='no_upper') with original candidate gates except the artificial endpoint>B gate; GEV uses audited NonnegativeGEV fit without artificial upper truncation; 768 TAIL selection draws, 50 bootstrap replicates, 2000 validation draws

no_upper_support_audit.gev_fit_class: NonnegativeGEV; empirical fallback recorded only when corrected fit rejects
